description: Alterations to existing single storey side extension including new roof at reduced height and new doors. Alterations to fenestration at lower ground and ground floor level. Landscaping works to front and rear. Replacement of front boundary with dwarf wall with railings and gates, installation of ASHP to rear. Internal alterations to lower ground floor and upper ground floor and associated works.
decision_conditions: <p>All new works and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile unless otherwise specified in the details hereby approved.</p><p>Reason: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<p>Proposed cornicing should not be installed until full details of the proposed works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>These details shall include:</p><p>1:1 scale drawings of the cornicing profile cross-sections.</p><p>1:5 scale elevation drawings showing the run and spacing of any decorative embellishments (such as modillions, dentils, or acanthus leaves).</p><p>A detailed specification of materials and manufacturing methods, confirming the use of traditional lime plaster or fibrous plaster run in-situ or pre-cast to match the original.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of any internal works to the floor, a full and detailed schedule of works and precise construction method statement for the lifting, lowering and alteration of the flooring shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>This should include. A precise numbering and labelling strategy for any fabric to be lifted.Full specifications of any proposed materials, strategy for underpinning if required and a clear protection methodology for historic floors remaining insitu during adjacent construction works.The development shall thereafter be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>Reason: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building and the works are undertaken in accordance with standard conservation good practice.</p><p><br></p>

<p>Detailed drawings or samples of materials as appropriate, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works. The work shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved, and shall be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p>a. stone paving and York stone steps</p><p>b. external windows and doors including the material, colour, finish, product information if available, and large scale drawings of each window (elevations at 1:20, sections and details at 1:5, showing the window and its masonry surround/reveal)</p><p>c. proposed external boundary treatments/fences/railings including the material, colour and finish, and larger scale plan, elevation and typical section drawings</p><p>d. proposed new or altered internal and external plumbing, waste pipes and ventilation routes for proposed shower room and kitchen</p><p>e. proposed vent and flue covers (internal and external) including scale drawings showing the locations of the proposed vents, product specifications, size, material, colour and finish.</p><p>f. insulation materials for wood fibre insulation with lime plaster at lower ground level and a Method Statement detailing how this will be undertaken.</p><p>g. new fireplaces to front and rear bedrooms upper ground</p><p>h. green roof on side extension</p><p>i. replacement bin store</p><p>Reason: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building</p>
